description: Compresses a local GLB the way the publisher exports it (Draco geometry and KTX2 textures, each on unless turned off) and publishes it as what the scene's visitors load. Send the GLB the scene was created from. Publishing again replaces it. Ambient occlusion and studio lights the scene's lighting asks to bake are not baked here, which needs a GPU: the result warns, and publishing from the Publisher bakes them.

path.description: A GLB file on this machine; relative paths start at the project.

sceneId.description: The scene, as list_scenes names it.
